notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.content:
A rather important update went live today. This build corrects all known matters and in particular addresses strangeness with the phone-related features. Additionally, players can now access the Astral Body, Command Manual and Chat Cat screens from the item menu. The Mac version of this patch should appear within the week. Well wishes and season tidings

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30650608/713785fec6de8425e0b4110760d7a76d2feed7c0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Now on Mac + Patch 2.3
notes.content:
As of tonight the Mac port is downloadable. Interestingly the port appears to perform better than its Windows counterpart in some regards. Our testing showed the game working at a distinctly higher frame rate and the monitor's colors and size seem better adjusted for its visuals.

In other news the build is current with patch 2.3. This patch addresses all known issues hitherto communicated in the forums. From this point it is unlikely future versions will be frequent.  

Peace and thanks for your patience!

notes.title: 2.0 Update
notes.content: With patch 2.0 the game has officially left beta. Most noticeably this patch corrects the use of the 'Toughen' skill and remedies some late-in-game instabilities. Thank you for your patience! Well wishes
